subject.title: Sub-agent model pin fidelity: requested vs effective model mismatch, no telemetry

question: What canonical contract should OpenClaw expose for requested, selected, effective, and upstream-resolved model identity across sub-agent lifecycle, Gateway session rows, and session_status?
rationale: Current main has partial model identity surfaces but no single durable contract; choosing public fields for provider/model/thinking and fallback state requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Canonical additive resolved fields
options.body: Add resolvedProvider, resolvedModel, fallbackUsed, and effective thinking metadata derived from responseModel and executionTrace while preserving existing selected-model fields.

options.title: Fold into broader issue
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/51441 the only canonical tracking item and keep this issue linked as sub-agent pin-fidelity context.

options.title: Reuse existing fields
options.body: Document modelProvider/model as the effective identity and avoid new Gateway fields, accepting that requested identity is only available elsewhere.

recommendation.title: Canonical additive resolved fields
recommendation.body: Add resolvedProvider, resolvedModel, fallbackUsed, and effective thinking metadata derived from responseModel and executionTrace while preserving existing selected-model fields.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent source history ties this person to the current session/status and embedded model attribution surfaces.
